selection: score-blind; hash order sha256(seed|stratum|type|task_id); one question per case/group; exclude tasks found in any earlier evaluation/review/audit file; exclude char 2-3gram TF-IDF cosine >= 0.85 to any training case or to an already selected question

strata.fresh_med: Medical Records cases never used as a task, evidence source or pilot in any earlier version (from the 100 unseen cases of the stage-4 real-retrieval pool)
strata.heldout_med: stage-4 held-out test split; never used for training/tuning; excluded if it appears in any real-retrieval, review, audit, near-duplicate or QA file

hallu_not_included: only 17 untouched Hallu test items remain and at most 4 fit the case diagnosis/principle scope; Hallu results stay exploratory in the paper
